ui.chat.ask_answer.eyebrow_waiting.note: The agent's question is shown below this label.
ui.chat.ask_answer.eyebrow_waiting.role: eyebrow label on the agent-question card while it awaits the user's reply

ui.chat.ask_answer.lost_to_reconnect.note: Runtime instance means the backend process the app talks to.
ui.chat.ask_answer.lost_to_reconnect.role: error on the composer when the app reconnected to a different backend instance before the answer was sent
ui.chat.ask_answer.lost_to_reconnect.tone: two short sentences, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.ask_answer.moved_on.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.ask_answer.moved_on.role: error on the composer when the user answers an ask that is no longer open
ui.chat.ask_answer.moved_on.tone: two-clause sentence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.ask_answer.not_sent.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.

placeholders.reason: why the send failed; the backend's message verbatim, or the localized fallback request_failed

ui.chat.ask_answer.not_sent.role: error on the composer when an answer failed to send

ui.chat.ask_answer.request_failed.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.ask_answer.request_failed.role: fallback reason used when an answer failed with no message of its own
ui.chat.ask_answer.request_failed.tone: one sentence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.ask_answer.secret_docked.note: A secret request asks for a password or key and has its own masked field.
ui.chat.ask_answer.secret_docked.role: error on the composer when the user types an answer to a secret request into the main message box
ui.chat.ask_answer.secret_docked.tone: one sentence with an em dash, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.ask_answer.session_unreachable.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.ask_answer.session_unreachable.role: reason sentence appended to the not-knowable lead when the session could not be reached
ui.chat.ask_answer.session_unreachable.tone: one sentence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.ask_answer.settled_elsewhere.note: An ask is a question the AI agent put to the user.
ui.chat.ask_answer.settled_elsewhere.role: error on the composer when the user answers an ask that another device or surface already settled
ui.chat.ask_answer.settled_elsewhere.tone: two-clause sentence, ends with a full stop

placeholders.reason: the reason sentence; either the backend's message verbatim or the localized fallback request_failed

ui.chat.ask_answer.unconfirmed.role: error joining the not-knowable sentence to the reason
ui.chat.ask_answer.unconfirmed.tone: two sentences joined by a space

ui.chat.ask_answer.unconfirmed_lead.note: Followed by a space and a second sentence explaining why.
ui.chat.ask_answer.unconfirmed_lead.role: first sentence of an error when the app cannot tell whether an answer reached the agent
ui.chat.ask_answer.unconfirmed_lead.tone: short sentence, ends with a full stop
